reason: The core claim holds (checked 20:28Z). The CONTEXT entries at 19:01Z and 19:05Z re-rank 28 Sep to five files (exp78a, exp78b, exp76e, exp79d, exp79a) with no amendment line. That uses every slot, but read table v2 (4) (l.3148) holds one slot for E10 until 12:00Z. The R19-A1 (3) fallbacks still name exp76c/exp76g, which were never built (experiments/ has neither), and exp70b-base files. With B = 0.956, exp70b-base files cannot show an UP on our LB row. Probe 46 (56611472) was still PENDING at the 20:25:10Z poll header, so a pre-46 amendment can still be registered honestly. Three parts are overstated or wrong. (a) v2 (6) bans knob rungs only in W3/W4 (l.3170), not in W1. The user lifted the public-knob-ladder ban on 26 Sep at 20:33Z (l.2388, l.2603), and aggressive mode (11:14Z/11:16Z, l.2940-2959) covers cap 8/12. So this is an unregistered deviation, not a rule breach. (b) The deadline 'before 00:05Z' clashes with the 'pre-46' label. 46 was submitted at 14:36:59Z, and at K2-like latency (7.4-7.7 h) it goes terminal at ~22:00-22:25Z. A line logged after that would be post-hoc. (c) exp76e's value depends on 46. If 46 < 0.956, exp76e attributes the drop to forkmid or thr 0.3; otherwise it only isolates forkmid (~5-9e-5). Its decision value is low either way, because the W2 stacks sit on exp70g without forkmid, so filler is right. The finding adds no mechanism and has no direct private or LB value. Its value is keeping the 28 Sep reads pre-registered and the E10 slot protected, and it is feasible: a CONTEXT line only, with no code, runtime or R1-R10 conflict.
fix: Log 'W1 v3 (post-45, pre-46)' BEFORE 46's terminal header (target <= 21:45Z; check the poll.log header shows 56611472 PENDING, and cite it). (4) ~01:45Z exp78b, marked as a two-knob read (cap 12 + FRAME_CAP 2); the cap line stops if exp78a reads NEG. (5) Slot 5 is held for E10 v3 until the earlier of 12:00Z or the last W1 terminal read, then goes to the W2 max stack of the + levers on the exp70g base. Pre-build that stack tonight (exp70g + SEC + CI and the two-lever variants) and queue its dummy, because CI dummies queue 2-3.3 h; without a PASSED dummy the slot stays empty or goes to E10. (6) Rows by 46: if 46 >= 0.957, W2 uses the exp70q base, and exp76c/76g are built only if a W2 slot needs them. If 46 <= 0.955, exp76e moves up to attribute forkmid vs thr0.3, but only if W2 has no stack. Otherwise exp76e is filler. (7) Supersede R19-A1 (2)/(3) and the 19:05Z list explicitly. (8) Tag the line: knob rungs in W1 under the user's 26 Sep 20:33Z lift and the 27 Sep 11:14Z/11:16Z aggressive mode, not a precedent; the W3/W4 ban in v2 (6) is unchanged.
realistic_gain: No direct score gain, public or private. It keeps the 28 Sep reads pre-registered, so the 29 Sep finals choice is not built on post-hoc rows. It also protects one E10 v3 slot (low-probability, high-value trigger) and stops slot 5 from being wasted on the filler exp76e or on an unbuilt W2 stack.
